rachel_marketing: Quick: need a one-page field brief for sales comparing security, SLAs, and which deploy mode to recommend (Hosted / Dedicated / Private). Keep scannable, 3 bullets per mode + 1-line decision flow.
sam_product: Got it. I'll draft bullets: compliance posture, data residency, isolation level, latency/throughput expectations.
diego_sales: Please add procurement notes (lead time) and a tiny pricing cue (reserved vs pay-as-you-go). AEs always ask.
keiko_eng: Add short tech caveats: quantization impact on accuracy (Dedicated can use lower-precision safely), caching/batching gains, and private installs need tuning.
rachel_marketing: Layout idea: left = 3-step decision flow, center = 3-row bullet table (security, SLA, pricing), right = 3 micro use-cases. Avoid paragraph walls.
sam_product: Draft bullets now: Hosted 1: fastest onboarding; TLS + encryption at rest; shared runtime; standard platform SLA 99.9% (typical p50 <2s); best for trials/proofs. Dedicated 1: isolated GPU pools + tenant VPCs; stronger throughput guarantees; 99.95% SLA; reserved pricing (monthly/annual); good for steady production. Private 1: customer-managed VPC or on-prem; KMS/HSM support + full audit logs; highest compliance (SOC2 + sector addenda); SLA and install cadence negotiated; ideal for regulated workloads.
diego_sales: Decision flow suggestion: strict compliance/KMS -> Private; predictable high qps -> Dedicated; quick POC/low compliance -> Hosted. Add checkbox for docs: DPA, SOC2 report, network peering details.
keiko_eng: Technical callouts to include: caching & batching reduce tokens/cost on Hosted/Dedicated; quantization note for Dedicated vs Private; automatic fallback routing to compatible variants on capacity issues.
rachel_marketing: (typo) thanks. I'll assemble and post draft here by noon. assign: sam (product copy), diego (sales checklist + procurement lead times), keiko (tech blurbs).
deploy-bot: uploaded /files/2071001234-onepage-deploy-compare-draft.pdf
diego_sales: quick pass done; adding example contract lengths (1 mo trial, 12/36 mo reserved).
rachel_marketing: perfect. final layout incoming. :sparkles:
